history.sentence: Nia wanted to play a duet with Mateo at the picnic.
She borrowed a little drum from the shelf.
She asked Mateo to play a duet at the picnic.
Mateo explained that he liked music, but he did not want to play before the audience.
Nia accepted his answer, and she played a soft beat on the little drum.
She wrote her name on a signup sheet for a solo.
Nia tried a different pattern on the little drum.
She performed the solo before the audience.
She invited Mateo to play a duet privately.
Nia left the choice with Mateo.
She returned the little drum to the shelf.
The little drum and a second drum were on the shelf, and the red ribbon hung between them.
